B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least/common denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator for unlike denominators
Solution converts fractions (or fractional parts of mixed numbers) to equivalent forms with the chosen denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only borrowing/regrouping is done without changing denominators between two different denominators

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once denominators match (or are already the same) by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution subtracts two fractions with like denominators (including producing 0 or a negative fraction)
Solution subtracts the fractional parts of mixed numbers after alignment
exclusion_criteria: Only whole-number subtraction is performed
Only simplification/reduction is performed without a subtraction operation

skills.name: Mixed-number regrouping
skills.definition: Rewrite or regroup whole and fractional parts (including borrowing 1 from the whole or rewriting a whole number as a mixed number/fraction) to enable valid subtraction and then recombine.
inclusion_criteria: Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a fractional part (e.g., 3 as 3 0/5 or 2 as 1 3/3)
Solution borrows/regroups from the whole part because the fractional subtraction would be negative
Solution converts a mixed number (including nonstandard like 1 4/3) into an improper fraction or equivalent form to subtract
exclusion_criteria: Pure fraction subtraction with no whole-part manipulation
Only reducing/simplifying after subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and express the final answer in an appropriate form (integer, proper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Solution reduces a fraction (e.g., 2/10 to 1/5, 9/12 to 3/4, 0/3 to 0)
Solution converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or recognizes an integer result) for the final response
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or performing subtraction without any reduction/formatting step
Intermediate conversions done solely to enable subtraction (covered by S01/S03) without final simplification/formatting

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (or use a given one) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts one or both fractions to an equivalent form with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work only subtracts numerators
Work only rewrites a whole number as n/n for borrowing (tag regrouping instead)

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two quantities once they are expressed with compatible parts (same denominator for fractions and/or separated whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b)
Subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number subtraction
Performs the core subtraction after conversion to improper fractions with a common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finds LCDs or rewrites forms without performing subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces the result without doing the subtraction

skills.name: Regroup to avoid negatives
skills.definition: Borrow/regroup 1 whole into fractional units (or rewrite a whole as a mixed number) so the fractional subtraction is nonnegative, then continue the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Fractional part subtraction becomes negative and the solution borrows 1 from the whole part
A whole number is rewritten as (whole−1) plus a full fraction (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3) to subtract a fraction
Shows adding n/n to the fractional part after decreasing the whole part by 1
exclusion_criteria: Negative fractional result is allowed and simply combined without borrowing (no regrouping step shown)
Only converts mixed numbers to improper fractions without any borrowing/regrouping

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and express the final answer appropriately as an integer, proper/improper fraction, or mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Explicitly reduces a fraction using a common factor (e.g., 2/10 = 1/5)
Converts 0/k to 0 or otherwise simplifies to an integer
Converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or combines whole+fraction into a mixed number) as the final form
exclusion_criteria: Only performs subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion
Only finds LCDs or borrows/regroups without simplifying/formatting the final result

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (or use a given common denominator) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts one or both fractions to an equivalent form with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work only subtracts numerators
Work only rewrites a whole number as a fraction (e.g., 4 = 12/3) without needing to align two different denominators

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once denominators are the same by subtracting numerators (including producing 0 or a negative fraction result).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts two fractions with like denominators (a/b − c/b)
Computes a fractional difference as part of a mixed-number subtraction (fraction part only)
exclusion_criteria: Step is only converting to a common denominator (no subtraction yet)
Step is only simplifying/reducing a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Mixed-number regrouping
skills.definition: Rewrite and combine whole and fractional parts in subtraction, including borrowing/regrouping from the whole when the fractional part would be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Separates subtraction into whole-part and fraction-part subtraction and then recombines
Borrows 1 from the whole to add an equivalent 1 = d/d to the fraction part
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a fractional part (e.g., 3 as 3 0/5 or 2 as 1 3/3) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number component
Only reduces/simplifies the final fraction without any whole/fraction recombination or borrowing

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and express the final answer in an appropriate form (integer, proper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Reduces a fraction using a common factor (e.g., 2/10 → 1/5, 9/12 → 3/4)
Converts 0/b to 0
Converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or otherwise formats the final result)
exclusion_criteria: Only performs the subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion
Only finds a common denominator or borrows/regroups without simplifying/formatting the final result
